sau_king_abdullah_sports_city.webp.note: Real stadium has a bowl shape with a distinctive faceted, 'jewel'-like exterior; this shows arched white canopy ribs, and the surroundings are wrong.

sau_king_fahd_international_stadium.webp.note: Plausible King Fahd Stadium: tent-like canopy with masts in desert; fewer masts than real, but acceptable.

jpn_kodaiji_jugyuan.webp.note: Kaiseki meal with a garden view; it fits a Kyoto teahouse restaurant. No people or text.

deu_konzerthaus_berlin.webp.note: Shows Gendarmenmarkt with the French Cathedral dome and flanking domed churches; the Konzerthaus has a different structure.

esp_loceanografic.webp.note: Shows City of Arts and Sciences (Hemisfèric, Príncipe Felipe museum, Assut d'Or bridge, Palau de les Arts), not L'Oceanogràfic.

fra_lorangerie.webp.note: Shows a citrus fennel salad on a plate, not the L'Orangerie museum or its building/gardens.

arg_la_bombonera.webp.note: Stadium resembles La Bombonera's blue-yellow boxy shape; no people or text visible.

ecu_la_compa_a_cloisters.webp.note: Shows a baroque church facade with a dome, not the La Compañía cloisters; the facade is also mismatched with Quito's.

bel_la_monnaie.webp.note: Statues in niches and pediment relief figures are visible; building resembles La Monnaie plausibly.

ind_laad_bazaar.webp.note: Charminar is drawn wrongly: it has two visible minarets and a tall arcaded block, not four minarets over four arches.

gha_labadi_beach.webp.note: Dim figures appear seated inside the right-hand beach hut, which counts as people.

mys_labuan_war_cemetery.webp.note: Headstones show illegible inscription-like markings; otherwise plausible Commonwealth war cemetery with Cross of Sacrifice and sea.

che_lake_geneva_tour.webp.note: Swiss flag on the boat is a symbol, not text; no people visible.

mus_le_caudan_waterfront.webp.note: Plausible waterfront with colonial buildings, hills and port cranes; no people or text visible.

fra_le_pr_catelan.webp.note: Shows a close-up plated dish, not the Le Pré Catelan restaurant, pavilion, or garden.

chn_li_hongzhang_former_residence.webp.note: Faint inscriptions/plaques on the wall and gate (e.g., left wall signage) appear as text-like characters.

irl_liffey_river_cruise.webp.note: Dark figure-like shapes appear inside the boat's windows, which could be passengers.

usa_lincoln_park_conservatory.webp.note: Grand domed Victorian glasshouse doesn't match Lincoln Park Conservatory's real design (low central palm house, no large ornate dome).

gbr_london_palladium.webp.note: Text 'PALLADIUM' visible on roof; real Palladium has a white-stucco facade with columned portico, not this brick building.

vnm_long_bien_bridge.webp.note: Cantilever truss bridge with stone piers matches Long Bien; no people or text visible.

kor_lotte_world_aquarium.webp.note: Shows a glass tower with a curved aquarium tank beside a river, not the real Lotte World Aquarium or Tower.

usa_luna_park.webp.note: Sun face on the arch is decorative, not human; no people or text visible.

aus_luna_park_melbourne.webp.note: Giant face is the landmark's architectural mascot entrance, not a person; no issues found.

aus_luna_park_sydney.webp.note: Giant face is the landmark's sculpture; faint unreadable marks on tower base, no people.

rus_luzhniki_stadium.webp.note: Stadium is a round open-ring bowl with a truss-roof; real Luzhniki is oval with a different colonnade and grand arena shape.

gbr_m_shed.webp.note: Shows a long brick shed with arched windows; M Shed is a different, more modest building with cranes.

usa_mall_of_america.webp.note: Shows a generic mall in flat farmland; Mall of America has a distinct four-anchor layout and an urban setting.

gbr_manchester_cathedral.webp.note: Shows a generic Gothic church with a central tower; Manchester Cathedral has a west tower and different layout.

phl_manila_cathedral.webp.note: Statues on facade are not people. Cathedral has twin spires and rose window, unlike the real Manila Cathedral's Romanesque single-tower-pair design.

bra_maracan.webp.note: Stadium roof is a closed oval ring with an open center; real Maracanã has different roof/facade structure.

ind_marina_beach.webp.note: Plausible generic beach promenade; Marina Beach has few palms and no such buildings, but acceptable.

sgp_marine_life_park.webp.note: Shows a generic aquarium with a big glass arch and lagoon; doesn't match Marine Life Park's Resorts World Sentosa architecture.

aus_melbourne_cricket_ground.webp.note: Stadium design is generic; MCG has distinct tiered stands, four tall light towers, and no blue-trussed roof.

aus_melbourne_skydeck.webp.note: Eureka Tower has a rectangular glass form with gold crown; this spiky tapered tower with side pod is inaccurate.

hun_memento_park.webp.note: Statues depict human figures (large statue and relief group); the scene matches Memento Park's statues and giant boot.

esp_mercado_de_la_ribera.webp.note: Stylized; resembles a railway-station hall more than the real market, but plausible.

usa_mercedes_benz_stadium.webp.note: Roof is a faceted dome with truss ring, not Mercedes-Benz Stadium's pinwheel retractable petal oculus roof.

esp_mestalla.webp.note: Stadium is a fully enclosed concrete bowl with arches and towers; the real Mestalla has a different, distinctive shape.

usa_metlife_stadium.webp.note: Stadium is a generic oval bowl with steel truss exterior; MetLife is angular, rectangular with distinctive panels.

hrv_mirogoj_cemetery.webp.note: Statues on tombs are present but no real people; the scene is a plausible Mirogoj-style arcaded cemetery with a green dome.

usa_missouri_botanical_garden.webp.note: Dome resembles the Climatron geodesic dome; surrounding Victorian buildings are plausible. No people or text visible.

pak_mohatta_palace_museum.webp.note: Mohatta Palace has pink and yellow stone with a distinct facade, and this looks like a generic Mughal-style palace.

bel_mont_des_arts.webp.note: Generic terraced garden with balustrades; plausible as Mont des Arts, though layout is stylized.

zaf_monte_casino_entertainment_complex.w.note: Clock face shows numerals/hands, but no readable text; Tuscan-style plaza plausibly resembles Montecasino.

fra_moulin_rouge.webp.note: Stylized but recognizable Moulin Rouge: red windmill and red entrance canopy. No people or text visible.

nzl_mount_eden.webp.note: Stone retaining wall around the crater rim is invented; the real Maungawhau crater has no such wall.

can_mount_royal_park.webp.note: Mount Royal cross is a lattice steel tower; here it's a stone monument. Skyline also inaccurate.

dom_museo_de_las_casas_reales.webp.note: Shows a generic two-story colonial house; the real Casas Reales has a larger multi-arched, balustraded facade.

usa_museum_of_science_and_industry.webp.note: Dome is centered and the building is too ornate. The real museum has a low dome with caryatid porches, and its lagoon is not shaped like this.

ukr_nsc_olimpiyskiy.webp.note: Stadium is a low oval bowl with white lattice roof; the real NSC Olimpiyskiy has a distinct tiered facade and a different shape.

chn_nanjing_city_wall.webp.note: Looks like a Badaling-style Great Wall on mountains, not Nanjing's brick city wall by a lake.

usa_national_aquarium.webp.note: Pier building is a generic blocky glass-and-concrete design; lacks the aquarium's signature glass pyramids and Baltimore Harbor landmarks.

rou_national_museum_of_art_of_romania.we.note: Generic domed Baroque palace; the real museum (former Royal Palace) has a different layout, with a central tower and no dome.

lka_national_museum_of_colombo.webp.note: Shows a generic colonial villa, not the National Museum of Colombo's distinctive white Italianate building with its central portico.

gbr_national_museum_of_scotland.webp.note: Shows a glass-roofed Victorian building with ornate gables, not the National Museum of Scotland's plain Chambers Street facade.

twn_national_theater.webp.note: Shows a generic palace hall with the Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall behind; National Theater's distinctive design is wrong.

cri_national_theatre_of_costa_rica.webp.note: Only statues on the roof, no real people; the building is a plausible match.

usa_new_england_aquarium.webp.note: Cylindrical glass tower on a stone pier doesn't match the New England Aquarium's rectangular, geometric glass-and-concrete design.

ken_ngong_hills.webp.note: Ngong Hills are a ridge of knuckle-like peaks; this shows rounded hills, but it is plausible.

hkg_ngong_ping_360.webp.note: Gondola cabins and pylons look plausible, but Ngong Ping 360 uses a bi-cable system with a different sea and mountain setting.

chn_oct_east.webp.note: Shows a European medieval castle and terraced tea fields, not OCT East's modern mountain resort, theme park, and architecture.

grc_odeon_of_herodes_atticus.webp.note: Odeon's facade is wrong: real one has three tiers of arches, and the seating is not a semicircle with a patterned orchestra.

nic_old_cathedral_of_managua.webp.note: Shows a ruined baroque church by the sea; the Old Cathedral of Managua is intact, with neoclassical twin towers and a dome, on a city plaza.

aus_old_melbourne_gaol.webp.note: Crenellated sandstone-trimmed wall with gate and slate-roofed block doesn't match the real bluestone, plain Old Melbourne Gaol.

usa_old_state_house.webp.note: Building resembles Independence Hall-style Georgian; Old State House's stepped gable, lion/unicorn and tower are wrong. Clock has numerals.

gbr_old_trafford.webp.note: Stadium looks like a generic brick ground with floodlight pylons, not Old Trafford's cantilever roof and open corners.

deu_olympiastadion_berlin.webp.note: Stadium is a closed oval with a full roof ring and blue track; the real Olympiastadion has an open west end, and its Marathon Gate and Maifeld bell tower layout differ.

nzl_one_tree_hill.webp.note: Depicts a grassy volcanic cone with an obelisk and trees, matching One Tree Hill. The lone pine is missing, but the scene is plausible.

fra_op_ra_bastille.webp.note: Plausible Opéra Bastille with July Column; glass and stone facade is stylized but recognizable.

fra_orange_velodrome.webp.note: Roof is a white oval ring with orange seats; the real Vélodrome has a distinctive curved canopy, and the surrounding setting looks inaccurate.

nor_oslo_cathedral.webp.note: Shows a yellow stone Gothic church; Oslo Cathedral is a baroque brick-and-plaster church with a different tower.

pol_ostr_w_tumski.webp.note: Poznań Cathedral has a single-towered, twin-towered brick Gothic façade with an apse and ambulatory; this shows a generic twin-tower church that doesn't match.

usa_pacific_park.webp.note: Ferris wheel hub shows lettering/logo; coaster is wooden and on the pier but layout differs from Pacific Park's real steel coaster.

fra_palais_garnier.webp.note: Statues and sculptures are present, but no real people. The Palais Garnier is depicted plausibly, though simplified.

fra_palais_longchamp.webp.note: Faint inscription band on central arch; statues present but no real people.
